questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why people catch more colds in the UK
Whether popular methods really boost the immune system
How Covid-19 spreads in winter
Why cold water swimming is dangerous
questions.why: They find out how useful techniques like foods, vitamins and cold water swimming are for the immune system.

questions.q: What does Georgie do to try to boost her immune system?
options: She eats lots of oranges
She swims in cold water every week
She drinks ginger shots
She takes turmeric
questions.why: Georgie says she tries to eat lots of oranges for vitamin C.

questions.q: How has presenter James Gallagher's winter been?
options: He hasn't been ill at all
He was quite ill in September but has been fine since then
He has felt ill almost all the time since November
He had one cold at Christmas
questions.why: He says he's 'felt constantly ill since about November'.

questions.q: Why does James ask Professor Eleanor Riley to 'back him up'?
options: Because she is a doctor who can treat him
Because she disagrees with everything the other guests have said so far
Because she has written a book about colds
Because the other guests haven't been very ill, unlike him
questions.why: John and Margaret have been mostly well, so James hopes someone will support his experience.

questions.q: What does Dr Margaret McCartney say about echinacea, turmeric and ginger shots?
options: They work only for children
They work if taken every day
They are useful for some people, but not for everyone
They don't help the immune system
questions.why: She answers 'No' to each one in the quick-fire round.

questions.q: What does Margaret say about nose sprays used at the start of an infection?
options: They are the best treatment available, much better than salt water
They are no better than a simple salt water spray
They can be harmful
They work better than vitamins
questions.why: She says they're 'not any better than normal saline spray – just salt water'.

questions.q: According to Professor John Tregoning, why might cold water swimming help people?
options: Being with friends reduces stress, which helps the immune system
The cold water kills viruses
It makes the body produce more cortisol, which makes it much stronger
Swimmers eat healthier food
questions.why: He says the social element reduces stress, and the stress chemical cortisol weakens the immune system.

questions.q: What does John suggest about other activities like dancing or singing?
options: They are less useful than swimming
They increase stress levels
They could give similar benefits
They should be done in cold places
questions.why: He says the benefit isn't unique to cold water swimming – you could get it from dancing, singing or running.
